UPPER(string_to_transform)
Returns the input string, transformed to uppercase. This function is not unicode
aware.
Parameters
string_to_transform: The string to transform.
Returns
The uppercase version of the string.
#Example
You might compare an incoming field of unknown case to a set of known values as
follows:
UPPER(/ticker) IN ('MSFT', 'IBM', 'RHAT', 'DIS')
